title: Commit to machine-readable conformance packages per component
requirements:
- State that each component requires a national implementation guide naming profiles, versions, actors and operations
- State that a companion conformance package will be published (architecture profile, validation rules, test cases, simulators, result schemas)
- Include security, events, test data and conformance tests
- Identify which constructs are native ArchiMate and which are DPI-H conventions
- Replace 'conventions' with specific normative profiles
- Define permitted relationships, mandatory properties and cardinalities for automated checks
- List the minimum interoperability conformance artefacts in 3.6.5
